name: Suspicious Certutil Download or Decode
description: Detects certutil.exe being used with -urlcache or -decode, a common living-off-the-land technique to download a remote file or decode a base64-smuggled payload using a signed Microsoft binary. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_win_certutil_download.yml, compiled from Sigma via sigma-cli (eql, ecs_windows pipeline).
false_positives: Rare legitimate certificate-management scripts that happen to use these flags
author: Sentinel
